== Description ==

The main event room of the [[2013 Match Play Championship]] in New Brunswick, New Jersey, on the evening of 26 January 2013, with the Players Committee banner on the back wall.

== Source and credit ==

Posted on the Players Committee forum: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=780624#p780624 Main Event Updates], post 780624, by The Smoking Gungan, 26 January 2013. Original attachment name: IMG_20130126_210448.jpg. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105010056/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t49918.html Internet Archive]
